## Summary

I extended the business-day rule in `OwnerRestControllerV1.java` to cover public holidays.

**Change** — in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- Added a `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set with the five fixed dates: `2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`.
- Updated `toBusinessDay(...)` so its roll-forward loop now also skips any date that falls on a listed holiday, in addition to Saturdays and Sundays. It keeps advancing one day at a time until it lands on a non-holiday weekday — so a holiday immediately followed by a weekend (or vice versa) rolls all the way through to the next real business day.

Since `toBusinessDay` is the single point through which the effective registration date passes, every derived value (daily-limit check, bulk-signup warning, audit log) automatically uses the holiday-adjusted date. This mirrors the reference `toBusinessDay`/`HOLIDAYS` logic that the acceptance-test base class (`AcceptanceBase`) uses to compute its expectations, and the full suite is green.
